title: Markhaatiyaashii Baaba'ay
intro: Waagii hore, bulsho waxay ku noolayd isgoys dhuleed oo u dhexeeya boqortooyooyin. Nebigoodu wuxuu ugu yeeray waddada runta, haddana waxay ku dheganaayeen gaalnimo iyo dulmi. Sheekadani waxay ku dhammaatay ciqaab rabbaani ah. Ma ka garan kartaa qarankan iyo qaddarkooda tilmaamaha hoose?
clues: Dad baa diiday digniintii uu keenay mid ka mid ah rasuulladooda.
Rasuulku wuxuu noogu yeeray inaan caabudno Alle oo keliya, wuxuuna ka digay musuqmaasuqa.
Xadgudubkeennu wuxuu ahaa in la diido nebigii naloo soo diray isagoo xaq ah.
Waxaan shaki ka qabnay awoodda rasuulka, waxaana ku eedaynay khiyaano.
Ciqaabtii ayaa na soo gaartay annagoo si ammaan ah ugu noolayn guryaheenna.
Waxaa naloo halaagay beenintii nebigeenna iyo dhibaatayntii mu'miniinta awgeed.

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Dadkii waxaa loo burburiyay gaalnimo awgeed.
Dadkii way toobad keeneen oo waa la hagaamiyay
Dadku way badbaadeen oo way barwaaqoobeen
Dadkii waxay u guureen dhul cusub
outcome.answer: Dadkii waxaa loo burburiyay gaalnimo awgeed.

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
